title: Minimum Length Substring
statement:
You are given a string S consisting of lowercase English letters.

Find the minimum length substring of S that contains all distinct characters present in the original string at least once.

If multiple substrings have the same minimum length, return the length of any one of them.

### Input Format
- A single string S consisting of lowercase English letters.

### Output Format
- Print a single integer representing the minimum length of a substring containing all distinct characters of S.

examples.explanation: The distinct characters in S are 'a', 'b', 'c', 'd'. The smallest substring containing all 4 characters is "dbca" of length 4.
The distinct characters are 'a', 'b'. The smallest valid substring is "ab" of length 2.
The distinct character is 'a'. The smallest valid substring is "a" of length 1.

constraints: String S contains only lowercase English letters.
hints: First find the total number of distinct characters in string S.
Use a sliding window with two pointers (left and right) and a frequency map/array to maintain character counts in the current window.
Expand right to include characters, and shrink left as long as the window maintains all distinct characters.
discussion: Classic sliding window approach. Time complexity O(N) and Space complexity O(26) ≈ O(1).
